title: The rhythm registry was restored on 2026-09-10 and the conductor reads all eleven families, yet nothing is ever enqueued
description: The rhythm registry was restored on 2026-09-10 and the conductor reads all eleven families, yet nothing is ever enqueued. The cause is not the registry and not the conductor: ten of the eleven families have no mechanism by which their staleness can ever rise, so they can never become due.
